narrative.summary: At its Tianjin summit on 1 September 2025, the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) adopted a statement on further deepening international cooperation on AI. Made by the leaders of nine member states (India is not among them), it supports the central role of the United Nations in AI decision-making and commits the signatories, on a voluntary basis, to cooperation on AI applications, talent training and investment, and to aligning development strategies, governance rules and technical standards.
lead_institutions: Council of Heads of State of the SCO
narrative.review_notes: The SCO Secretariat's publications and the Chinese foreign ministry's texts of SCO summit documents were checked in November 2026. Not yet confirmed from an official text: an SCO memorandum of understanding on AI referred to in the Bishkek Declaration of September 2026, and a 2025 roadmap for AI cooperation among member states.

instruments.summary: Statement adopted at the Tianjin summit by the leaders of nine SCO member states (Belarus, Iran, Kazakhstan, China, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Russia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan). It supports the UN's central role in AI decision-making, commits members on a voluntary basis to international cooperation on AI applications and to AI talent training through university cooperation and academic exchange, and to use the SCO Interbank Consortium to support members' AI investment projects. It calls for aligning development strategies, governance rules and technical standards while respecting national sovereignty, and for developing safe, responsible AI and trustworthy AI systems.
instruments.current_status: Adopted at Tianjin on 1 September 2025 (date line of the text). Russian text published by the SCO Secretariat; the Chinese text (上海合作组织成员国元首理事会关于进一步深化人工智能国际合作的声明) is also published by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs. India is not among the leaders named in the preamble.

leads.title: SCO Memorandum of Understanding on Artificial Intelligence (上合组织成员国人工智能领域谅解备忘录) and Bishkek Declaration AI paragraph (1 Sep 2026)
leads.note: The Bishkek Declaration on the SCO's 25th anniversary (1 September 2026, Bishkek; Chinese text on the Chinese foreign ministry site) says AI must be applied safely and responsibly and 'stresses the importance of signing' the SCO memorandum of understanding on AI; signature and the memorandum text are not confirmed. The declaration itself mentions AI only in passing (scope test).

leads.title: Roadmap for the Implementation of the Development Plan for Cooperation in the Field of AI among SCO Member States (Chengdu, 12 Jun 2025)
leads.note: Known only from a newsletter; no official text found, nor of the underlying Development Plan for AI cooperation. The SCO statement on the digital economy of 1 September 2025 (mfa.gov.cn t20250902_11700019) does not mention AI.
